_comment: Framing flags from scripts/check-portrait-framing.mjs that a person has already looked at.
KEYED ON (url, sha256), and the HASH IS THE LOAD-BEARING HALF: our storage overwrites a
file in place at the same URL, so a URL-keyed record would go on muting that path after a
completely different picture was uploaded to it. Any change to the bytes lapses the entry
and the picture is judged again from scratch.
kind "defect"   = a real manufactured surround, still published, NOT YET RE-SOURCED. This
is a WORK QUEUE. It is listed TODO on every run and the number should
kind "accepted" = a real photograph this gate is wrong about, with the reason written out.
A defect filed as an acceptance is a defect nobody will ever fix. Do not move one across
to make a red build green.
DRAINED 2026-11-10 by CC_0384: all 11 defects this file opened with are gone from production.
Nine were replaced (two state seals, four oval crops, one arched mask, two pillarboxed, one
letterboxed) and two were blanked, because no rectangular portrait of them exists at a usable
size. The one entry left is an ACCEPTANCE and always was.
measured: 2026-11-09 over all 9,481 published headshots (both columns); the 11 defects it found were fixed by CC_0384 on 2026-11-10

entries.name: Che' Alexander
entries.why: a real cut-out portrait on plain white. The BORDER branch cannot tell a uniform BACKGROUND from a FRAME when the subject reaches no edge: every edge line is flat white, so all four "border depths" are real and there is no frame.
